title: client-survey.md still lists as missing what the agent now has
description:
Found during the prose pass over the docs. The pass was prose only, so this was left.

client-survey.md §1.1 lists three things 'the agent does not have' for bouncer mode, the first being 'a listener that is not loopback, with TLS', and calls it open question 1. That question is settled twice over: by this same note's decision S1, and then by decision mimid-1wgh.92, which lets plain [irc] listen take any address. §1.1's own opening sentence already describes the current behaviour, and both front ends have listen_tls. §2's 'Risks. Bouncer mode needs the non-loopback listener (question 1)' carries the same stale framing.

AGENTS.md: 'Answering another note's open question means editing that note. A design note's Uncertainties section is a claim about what is not known. When later work settles one of its entries, say so there in the same commit.' That did not happen when mimid-1wgh.92 landed. The fix is to rewrite §1.1's three items as what remains, the way §1.3's five store gaps were already rewritten once they were built, and to drop or restate question 1 in §2.

SEPARATELY, §11's first Uncertainties entry and the §2 table's Palaver row both record, dated 2026-11-21, that Palaver may no longer be sold. The §2 step 8 'Only if Palaver is still sold' depends on it and nobody has rechecked.
